title: Chapter 8 — Precious
description: Precious laughs louder than anyone in the bar. Her boyfriend Jide is why. He has come to take her home, and her money.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Saturday. Precious has a bruise she says is from the kitchen door. The kitchen door has never hit anybody.

beats.speaker: jide
beats.text: (at the gate, in a borrowed suit, smiling with every tooth) Madam. I'm Precious's fiancé. I have come to collect her. And her savings. We are getting married. She keeps it with you, abi? The savings.

beats.speaker: player
beats.text: (Precious is behind the bar. She is not laughing.)

beats.speaker: player
beats.text: Jide is very relaxed. Men like Jide always are.

options.text: "Precious, do you want to go with him?" Ask her in front of him.
"Kokoro. Escort this gentleman to the gate. Permanently."
Give him her savings. It's her life.

beats.speaker: precious
beats.text: (after a very long time, very quietly) No.

beats.speaker: jide
beats.text: (not smiling now) She doesn't mean that. (He steps forward.)

won.toast: Jide leaves without his borrowed suit jacket. Precious hangs it on the bar like a trophy.

lost.toast: Jide leaves on his own feet, promising to come back. Kokoro sleeps at the gate with his eyes open for a week.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Precious goes with Jide and her savings on Sunday. On Wednesday she is back, without the savings, with a new bruise and a smaller laugh. She doesn't look at you for a week.

beats.speaker: precious
beats.text: (that night, at the bar) Mama. I want to learn something. Not hair, Blessing has that. Something with numbers, like Kemi. Can I?

beats.speaker: precious
beats.text: She has never asked for anything before.

options.text: "Kemi will teach you the books. You start Monday."
Pay for a computer course at the polytechnic.

beats.title: Precious
beats.summary: A man came to take a woman from your house. What the girls learned about you that day, they won't forget.
